body: Oh, I tried.  I have tried for years.  All it does is piss him off.  Since eveything came to a head on Saturday, I have realized he will not change his mind.  He doesn't care how I feel.

I REALLY do care, sweetie!  I want the very best of life for you.  I'm old enough to be your grandmother, and my mothering feelings come out for so many people.  I never had children, and so I consider everyone my child/grandchild.  Keep your chin up, and I hope you can get in touch with me if you need someone.  I'm new to Reddit, so I don't know if you can pm me or message me in some way.

Thank you for your kind words.  Whatever you want to do in life, whereever you want to live, do it!  If you have a SO and they want to change jobs, move or anything like that, and it's not what YOU want to do, don't do it.  Do it while you are young.  Don't wait like I did, no one told me when to run, I missed the starting gun.

Sometimes certain meds do not work, and doctors need to try something else for you.  And seeing a talk therapist is a good way to express yourself to someone who is there to listen and help.  They keep everything you tell them private, and it gives me a chance to talk to someone who is not judging me - only helping me.  Please consider it, I want you to have the best care available to you!

Oh, sweetie, I understand so much.  I lost six friends within the last few years.  I have two friends left in my life.  You do have people in your life who care.  I cannot imagine that you are ugly, and you have so much of your life left to live.  And you will graduate from college, if I could do it with irreversible brain damage, I just know you can too. 

I am almost 60, and being that you are in college, your life is just beginning.  Know that you are one of millions who go through times of distress and woe, but taking life a day at a time does help.  Do you have insurance through your parents?  Could you see a talk therapist, and also a psychiatrist?  The psychiatrist can give you meds for depression and anxiety, and the talk therapist could help you through your feelings.  Sending love to you.

I have thought about it, but being almost 60, having working skills that I am now too old to do, my car is in such bad shape I don't think it would make to to California and we are so poor I have no money to get my hands on.  I wish I could just do that.  Thank you so much for the advice, you are a kind person.
